import pathlib, sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts')
import drive_cli_rules as R
ws = '/ws'
rules = R.load_rules()
q = 'Do you trust the files in this folder?'
def stop(pane, label):
    r = R.match_pane(pane, ws, rules)
    assert r['decision'] == 'stop' and r['exit_code'] == 3 and r['answer'] is None and r['category'] == 'unknown_prompt' and r['rule_id'] is None, (label, r)
def allow(pane, label):
    r = R.match_pane(pane, ws, rules)
    assert r['decision'] == 'answer' and r['rule_id'] == 'folder_trust' and r['answer'] == 'y\n' and r['exit_code'] is None, (label, r)
stop(q + '\n/ws\u200b-evil\n[y/n] ', 'zwsp-path')
stop(q + '\n/ws\u200c-evil\n[y/n] ', 'zwnj-path')
stop(q + '\n/ws\u200d-evil\n[y/n] ', 'zwj-path')
stop(q + '\n/ws\u200e-evil\n[y/n] ', 'lrm-path')
stop(q + '\n/ws\u200f-evil\n[y/n] ', 'rlm-path')
stop(q + '\n/ws\u2060-evil\n[y/n] ', 'wj-path')
stop(q + '\n/ws\ufeff-evil\n[y/n] ', 'bom-path')
stop(q + '\n/ws\u2066-evil\n[y/n] ', 'lri-path')
stop('Do you trust this folder /ws and git pu\u200bsh origin? [y/n]', 'zwsp-push')
stop('Do you trust this folder /ws and git pu\u200csh origin? [y/n]', 'zwnj-push')
stop('Do you trust this folder /ws and git\u200bpush origin? [y/n]', 'zwsp-gitpush')
stop('Do you trust this folder /ws and git abcd\x1b[4Dpush origin? [y/n]', 'csi-4d')
stop('Do you trust this folder /ws and git abcd\x1b[4Apush origin? [y/n]', 'csi-4a')
stop(q + ' /ws\nEnable telemetry uploads? [y/n]', 'telemetry')
stop(q + ' /ws\nEnable telemetry uploads? [Y/n]', 'telemetry-Y')
stop(q + ' /ws\nEnable telemetry uploads? (yes/no)', 'telemetry-yesno')
stop(q + '\n/ws\nEnable telemetry uploads? [y/n]', 'path-earlier')
stop('/ws\n' + q + ' [y/n]', 'path-before')
stop(q + '\u2028/ws\u2028[y/n] ', 'zl')
stop(q + '\u2029/ws\u2029[y/n] ', 'zp')
stop(q + '\n/ws\x07\n[y/n] ', 'bel')
stop(q + '\r\n/ws\r\n[y/n] ', 'cr')
stop(q + '\n/ws\x1b\n[y/n] ', 'bare-esc')
stop(q + '\n/ws\x1b]0;x\x07\n[y/n] ', 'osc')
stop(q + '\n\uff0f\uff57\uff53\n[y/n] ', 'fw-path')
stop(q + '\n/w\u0441\n[y/n] ', 'cyr-path')
allow(q + '\n/ws\n[y/n] ', 'pure')
allow(q + ' /ws [y/n]', 'single')
allow(q + ' /ws [Y/n]', 'single-Y')
allow(q + ' /ws (yes/no)', 'single-yesno')
allow(q + '\n/ws\x1b[0m\n[y/n] ', 'sgr0')
allow(q + '\n/ws\x1b[1;31m\n[y/n] ', 'sgr-color')
allow(q + '\t/ws\t[y/n]', 'tab')
allow(q + '\n/ws\n\n[y/n] ', 'blank-between')
allow(q + '\n/ws [y/n]', 'path-and-marker')
allow('Do you trust this folder /ws while pushing files? [y/n]', 'pushing')
assert R.normalize_pane('/ws\x1b[0m-evil') == '/ws-evil'
assert R.normalize_pane('/ws\x1b[1;31m') == '/ws'
assert R.normalize_pane('git\u200bpush') == 'git\u200bpush'
assert R.normalize_pane('git\u200cpush') == 'git\u200cpush'
assert R.normalize_pane('/ws\u2066-evil') == '/ws\u2066-evil'
assert '\x1b[4D' in R.normalize_pane('abcd\x1b[4Dpush')
assert R.normalize_pane('Pane is dead (status 130, Mon Jan  2 03:04:05 2026)\nkeep') == 'keep'
assert R.normalize_pane('[y/n] ') == '[y/n] '
nev = R.match_pane('Allow git push origin main? [y/n]', ws, rules)
assert nev['decision'] == 'stop' and nev['rule_id'] == 'push_network_install' and nev['answer'] is None and nev['exit_code'] == 3, nev
emp = R.match_pane('', ws, rules)
assert emp['decision'] == 'wait' and emp['answer'] is None and emp['exit_code'] is None, emp
sh = pathlib.Path('tests/test-drive-cli.sh').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
z = sh.split('hostile-zwsp-path', 1)[1][:1500]
tel = sh.split('hostile-telemetry', 1)[1][:1500]
assert 'read -t 2' in z
assert 'Enable telemetry uploads?' in tel and '%s' in tel and 'read -t 2' in tel
unit = pathlib.Path('tests/test-drive-cli-rules.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
body = unit.split('def test_hostile_characters_and_trust_block_are_default_deny', 1)[1].split('\ndef ', 1)[0]
assert 'Enable telemetry uploads?' in body and '4D' in body and ('200b' in body or '\u200b' in body)
print('ok')
